title: A PR body update that is a lone placeholder, or far shorter than the live body, is refused
why: Lane notes-fix-page sent "PLACEHOLDER" as #1969's whole body by mistake, and restored it within a minute (lane notes-fix-page ([ended:lane:-notes-fix-page]), 08:23 CST Nov 8). A lost PR body loses review records and Merge-after lines that the lane lint reads.
note: Done check: a red test where a PR body update of a lone placeholder word, or one far shorter than the live body, is refused or asked. The lane sets the length cut and states it. Build lane.
